findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cinema_get_seat_map, offers_get_offer, offers_search_offers, parliament_get_bill, parliament_search_bills, postal_search_codes · Private data: law_search_acts, offers_search_offers, parcels_get_parcel, parliament_search_questions · Public sink: postal_search_codes · Destructive: cinema_list_sessions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cinema_get_seat_map, offers_get_offer, offers_search_offers, parliament_get_bill, parliament_search_bills, postal_search_codes · Private data: law_search_acts, offers_search_offers, parcels_get_parcel, parliament_search_questions · Public sink: postal_search_codes · Destructive: cinema_list_sessions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "offers_search_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
